arxiv-1609-01555.title: Inverse moment problem for non-Abelian Coxeter double Bruhat cells
arxiv-1609-01555.creator: Michael Gekhtman
arxiv-1609-01555.description: Abstract . We solve the inverse problem for non-Abelian Coxeter double Bruhat cells in terms of the matrix Weyl functions. This result can be used to establish complete integrability of the non-Abelian version of nonlinear Coxeter-Toda lattices in G ​ L n GL_{n} . \pagespan 117136 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 47B36; Secondary 37K10 1.

arxiv-2107-07669.title: Automating Induction by Reflection
arxiv-2107-07669.creator: Johannes Schoisswohl, Laura Kovács
arxiv-2107-07669.description: Abstract Despite recent advances in automating theorem proving in full first-order theories, inductive reasoning still poses a serious challenge to state-of-the-art theorem provers. The reason for that is that in first-order logic induction requires an infinite number of axioms, which is not a feasible input to a computer-aided theorem prover requiring a finite input.

arxiv-2303-15567.title: Wormhole Model for Neon-20
arxiv-2303-15567.description: Abstract A quantum mechanical model for the Neon-20 nucleus is developed that allows for the splitting of a bipyramidal structure of five alpha-partices into an alpha-particle and an Oxygen-16 nucleus. The geometry of the configuration space is assumed to be a 3-dimensional spatial wormhole, and on the wormhole background there is an attractive short-range potential.

arxiv-2304-03075.title: Exact asymptotics of ruin probabilities with linear Hawkes arrivals
arxiv-2304-03075.creator: Zbigniew Palmowski, Simon Pojer, Stefan Thonhauser
arxiv-2304-03075.description: Abstract . In this paper we determine bounds and exact asymptotics of the ruin probability for risk process with arrivals given by a linear marked Hawkes process. We consider the light-tailed and heavy-tailed case of the claim sizes. Main technique is based on the principle of one big jump, exponential change of measure, and renewal arguments. Keywords.

arxiv-2405-10918.title: A Framework for Leveraging Partially-Labeled Data for Product Attribute-Value Identification
arxiv-2405-10918.creator: D. Subhalingam, Keshav Kolluru, Mausam, Saurabh Singal
arxiv-2405-10918.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by D. Subhalingam, Keshav Kolluru, Mausam, Saurabh Singal. In the e-commerce domain, the accurate extraction of attribute-value pairs (e.g., Brand : Apple ) from product titles and user search queries is crucial for enhancing search and recommendation systems. A major challenge with neural models for this task is the lack of high-quality training data, as the annotations for attribute-value pairs in the available datasets are often incomplete.

arxiv-2405-13209.title: Investigating Symbolic Capabilities of Large Language Models
arxiv-2405-13209.creator: Neisarg Dave, Daniel Kifer, C. Lee Giles, Ankur Mali
arxiv-2405-13209.description: Abstract Prompting techniques have significantly enhanced the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) across various complex tasks, including reasoning, planning, and solving math word problems. However, most research has predominantly focused on language-based reasoning and word problems, often overlooking the potential of LLMs in handling symbol-based calculations and reasoning.

arxiv-2408-11178.title: Mean-field and fluctuations for hub dynamics in heterogeneous random networks
arxiv-2408-11178.creator: Zheng Bian, Jeroen S.W. Lamb, Tiago Pereira
arxiv-2408-11178.description: Abstract Abstract. We study a class of heterogeneous random networks, where the network degree distribution follows a power-law, and each node dynamics is a random dynamical system, interacting with neighboring nodes via a random coupling function. We characterize the hub behavior by the mean-field, subject to statistically controlled fluctuations.

arxiv-2408-16629.title: LLMs Generate Structurally Realistic Social Networks But Overestimate Political Homophily
arxiv-2408-16629.creator: Serina Chang, Alicja Chaszczewicz, Emma Wang, Maya Josifovska, Emma Pierson, Jure Leskovec
arxiv-2408-16629.description: Abstract Generating social networks is essential for many applications, such as epidemic modeling and social simulations. The emergence of generative AI, especially large language models (LLMs), offers new possibilities for social network generation: LLMs can generate networks without additional training or need to define network parameters, and users can flexibly define individuals in the network using natural language.

arxiv-2505-18546.title: ReflectGAN: Modeling Vegetation Effects for Soil Carbon Estimation from Satellite Imagery
arxiv-2505-18546.creator: Dristi Datta, Manoranjan Paul, Manzur Murshed, Shyh Wei Teng, and Leigh M. Schmidtke
arxiv-2505-18546.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dristi Datta, Manoranjan Paul, Manzur Murshed, Shyh Wei Teng, and Leigh M. Schmidtke. Soil organic carbon (SOC) is a critical indicator of soil health, but its accurate estimation from satellite imagery is hindered in vegetated regions due to spectral contamination from plant cover, which obscures soil reflectance and reduces model reliability. This study proposes the Reflectance Transformation Generative Adversarial Network (ReflectGAN), a novel paired GAN-based framework designed to reconstruct accurate bare soil reflectance from vegetated soil satellite observations.

pmc-10654777.title: Expression of oncogenic HRAS G12V causes defects in control of cell size in NIH 3T3 cells
pmc-10654777.creator: Jerry T. DeWitt, Michael V. Sharma, Douglas R. Kellogg
pmc-10654777.description: Severe defects in control of cell size are closely associated with cancer. However, the mechanisms that drive cell size defects in cancer remain unknown and it is unclear whether they are a direct consequence of signals from primary oncogenic drivers or a secondary consequence of mutations that accumulate during evolution of cancer cells.

pmc-11444111.title: Serum tumor necrosis factor-alpha status in hospitalized patients with coronavirus disease-2019 (COVID-19)
pmc-11444111.creator: Mansour Babaei, Behzad Heidari, Mahmoud Sadeghi Haddad Zavareh, Zahra Ahmadnia, Hossein Ghorbani, Samaneh Rouhi

pmc-11465859.title: Targeted regulation of 5-aminolevulinic acid enhances flavonoids, anthocyanins and proanthocyanidins accumulation in Vitis davidii callus

However, their availability is limited by resource constraints. Plant cell culture has emerged as a valuable approach for anthocyanin production and serves as an ideal model to investigate the regulation of anthocyanin biosynthesis.

pmc-11472309.title: In Situ Functionalization of Polar Polythiophene-Based Organic Electrochemical Transistor to Interface In Vitro Models
pmc-11472309.creator: Sebastian Buchmann, Pepijn Stoop, Kim Roekevisch, Saumey Jain, Renee Kroon, Christian Müller, Mahiar M. Hamedi, Erica Zeglio, Anna Herland
pmc-11472309.description: Organic mixed ionic-electronic conductors are promising materials for interfacing and monitoring biological systems, with the aim of overcoming current challenges based on the mismatch between biological materials and convectional inorganic conductors. The conjugated polymer/polyelectrolyte complex poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):polystyrenesulfonate (PEDOT/PSS) is, up to date, the most widely used polymer for in vitro or in vivo measurements in the field of organic bioelectronics.

pmc-11505270.title: Three-Dimensional Analysis of Vocal Fold Oscillations: Correlating Superior and Medial Surface Dynamics Using Ex Vivo Human Hemilarynges
pmc-11505270.creator: Reinhard Veltrup, Susanne Angerer, Elena Gessner, Friederike Matheis, Emily Sümmerer, Jann-Ole Henningson, Michael Döllinger, Marion Semmler
pmc-11505270.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The primary acoustic signal of the voice is generated by the complex oscillation of the vocal folds (VFs), whereby physicians can barely examine the medial VF surface due to its anatomical inaccessibility. In this study, we investigated possibilities to infer medial surface dynamics by analyzing correlations in the oscillatory behavior of the superior and medial VF surfaces of four human hemilarynges, each in 24 different combinations of flow rate, VF adduction, and elongation.

pmc-11647394.title: Empagliflozin in patients with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (EMPA-PKD): study protocol for a randomised controlled trial

pmc-11647394.description: IntroductionAutosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) is a hereditary condition that causes the formation of cysts primarily in the kidneys. The continuous growth of multiple cysts leads to the destruction of functional parenchyma, which may progress to end-stage kidney disease. Tolvaptan is the only drug specifically approved for slowing down the progression of ADPKD.

pmc-12575339.creator: Robert Stewart, Xoel Souto Guitián, Ophélie Gervais, Yehwa Jin, Sarah J. Salisbury, Maeve Ballantyne, Samuel A. M. Martin, Beatriz Orosa-Puente, Diego Robledo

pmc-13652677.title: 黄芩清热除痹胶囊抑制类风湿关节炎成纤维样滑膜细胞炎症及增殖的机制
pmc-13652677.creator: 月迪 胡, 健 刘
pmc-13652677.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的明确烷基化修复同源蛋白5（ALKBH5）/环状RNA0091685（circ_0091685）/真核起始因子4A-Ⅲ（eIF4A3）轴在类风湿关节炎成纤维样滑膜细胞（RA-FLS）中的作用，并探讨黄芩清热除痹胶囊（HQC）是否通过该轴调控RA-FLS炎症及增殖。方法基于基因表达综合数据库（GEO）中的微阵列数据集筛选类风湿关节炎患者与健康人群的差异表达基因，并进行基因本体（GO）、京都基因和基因组数据库（KEGG）富集分析以筛选差异表达基因相关的生物学过程和作用通路。建立外周血单个核细胞和RA-FLS共培养模型，通过过表达或沉默ALKBH5、circ_0091685、EIF4A3，以及突变circ_0091685的N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）位点，验证ALKBH5是否通过介导circ_0091685 m6A修饰靶向eIF4A3影响RA-FLS炎症及增殖。同时建立佐剂性关节炎大鼠模型，观察HQC对大鼠的影响，并通过HQC含药血清作用于RA-FLS探索ALKBH5/circ_0091685/eIF4A3轴在HQC发挥疗效过程中的作用机制。在体外实验中，采用5-乙炔基-2 ´ -脱氧尿苷（EdU）染色检测细胞增殖能力、酶联免疫吸附试验检测炎症因子水平、逆转录定量聚合酶链反应检测EIF4A3和circ_0091685表达水平、蛋白质印迹法检测ALKBH5和eIF4A3表达水平、RNA免疫共沉淀法验证circ_0091685与eIF4A3结合、比色法及RNA甲基化免疫共沉淀-定量聚合酶链反应检测m6A修饰水平；在体内实验中，采用苏木精-伊红染色、番红O-固绿染色和甲苯胺蓝染色观察大鼠膝关节组织病理变化。结果GEO中，类风湿关节炎患者样本与健康人群样本的前20个差异表达基因包括ALKBH5和EIF4A3。GO分析显示生物学过程存在甲基化修饰，KEGG分析显示富集通路包括IL-17信号通路等。与ALKBH5沉默对照组比较，ALKBH5沉默组ALKBH5、circ_0091685、eIF4A3、IL-6、IL-17A、IL-23、TNF-α表达均减少，EdU相对阳性细胞数减少（均P<0.01），而ALKBH5过表达组则相反。与ALKBH5过表达+circ_0091685对照组比较，ALKBH5过表达+circ_0091685突变组炎症因子IL-6、IL-17A、IL-23、TNF-α表达均显著减少（均P<0.01）。RNA免疫共沉淀检测结果显示，circ_0091685可与eIF4A3特异性结合。沉默circ_0091685或EIF4A3均能降低细胞中炎症因子IL-6、IL-17A、IL-23、TNF-α表达水平，EdU相对阳性细胞数减少（均P<0.01），而过表达circ_0091685或EIF4A3则相反。HQC干预后，佐剂性关节炎大鼠膝关节组织病理有所改善。HQC含药血清干预后，RA-FLS中IL-6、IL-17A、IL-23、TNF-α、ALKBH5、circ_0091685、eIF4A3表达减少且EdU相对阳性细胞数减少（均P<0.05），而总RNA m6A和circ_0091685 m6A水平升高（均P<0.05）；在加入HQC含药血清基础上过表达ALKBH5能升高IL-6、IL-17A、IL-23、TNF-α表达水平（均P<0.01）；在加入HQC含药血清基础上过表达circ_0091685亦能升高IL-6、IL-23、TNF-α表达水平（均P<0.01）。此外，加入HQC含药血清或沉默circ_0091685均能降低IL-6、IL-23、TNF-α及eIF4A3表达（均P<0.01），表明HQC含药血清和沉默circ_0091685具有协同作用关系。结论HQC通过调控ALKBH5介导的circ_0091685 m6A修饰靶向eIF4A3抑制RA-FLS炎症及增殖。 RA是一种炎症性自身免疫病，可引起关节破坏，严重时可致关节畸形［1-2］。炎症刺激伴随RA发展全过程，慢性炎症刺激RA-FLS异常增殖、迁移，加速促炎性细胞因子分泌，加快骨侵袭和骨破坏［3-4］。RNA修饰是真核生物重要的转录后表观遗传修饰［5］。RNA的不同碱基上存在着约10种不同的甲基化标记，其中m6A是mRNA上最广泛的甲基化修饰［6］，ALKBH5是m6A修饰的关键去甲基化酶。研究显示，环状RNA m6A修饰参与肿瘤、胰腺炎、骨关节炎等多种炎症相关疾病的进展［7-10］，ALKBH5介导的去甲基化修饰显著影响RA的滑膜增生和侵袭［11］。本团队前期研究利用RA患者PBMC进行全转录组高通量测序检测了环状RNA表达谱，得到165个环状RNA，进一步通过生物信息学分析和RT-qPCR实验筛选获得了一个与RA免疫炎症相关且在RA患者中高表达的环状RNA——hsa_circ_0091685（以下简称circ_0091685）［12］。 健脾清热通络方的代表制剂HQC是安徽中医药大学第一附属医院的院内制剂，具有清热利湿、祛风止痛、健脾通络之功效。前期研究通过超高效液相色谱-串联质谱、指纹图谱对HQC的核心成分进行了鉴定，证明其核心成分黄芩苷、栀子苷、木犀草素、齐墩果酸、薏苡素、苦杏仁苷等含量较高、稳定性良好［13-14］。临床观察和动物实验证明HQC在缓解RA患者炎症反应和降低佐剂性关节炎大鼠炎症细胞、滑膜组织水肿中的作用［15-16］。然而，既往研究尚未从表观遗传修饰的角度探讨HQC抗炎和抗增殖的作用机制。本研究首先通过生物信息学筛选出ALKBH5和EIF4A3是RA的差异表达基因，初步探究其在m6A甲基化修饰中的作用。在此基础上，进一步结合体内外实验验证HQC通过ALKBH5介导circ_0091685 m6A修饰抑制RA-FLS炎症及增殖的机制，旨在为HQC临床应用于RA治疗提供科学依据。 材料与方法 数据来源及处理 在GEO中检索关键词“rheumatoid arthritis”、“homo sapiens”和“expression profiling by array”。微阵列数据集包括RA患者样本和健康人群样本，最终筛选出信息完整的23个数据集，包括16个RA患者样本和7个健康人群样本。使用R 4.2.3软件对芯片数据进行预处理，通过“normalize”包归一化处理、“sva”包去除批次效应后得到的数据用于后续分析。
